signal: Alkira launched its Connect Partner Program in March 2026 and is being acquired by Lumen Technologies

email.body1:
Samantha, saw Alkira launched the Connect Partner Program and is heading into the Lumen acquisition.

Moments like that flood the funnel, and the real bottleneck for an SDR team is follow-up volume and ramp time, not lead count. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and runs the follow-up autonomously, so your reps spend their time in live conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Samantha, quick follow-up for Alkira.

With demand spiking around Connect and the Lumen news, response speed decides which inbound and signals actually convert, and new reps take months to ramp to that. The worker handles research and first-touch instantly so your team follows up on day one.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I'd make. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Samantha, last bit of proof for Alkira.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alkira's reply rate likely compares to other infrastructure teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Samantha, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up volume off your reps isn't a priority during the Lumen transition, no problem at all. Timing matters, and an acquisition quarter is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I'll tailor it to Alkira either way.
